description: Evaluate up to 100 actions via the streaming endpoint. The tool buffers the SSE stream and returns the complete result set (same shape as atlasent_evaluate_many). Per-item RPC failures surface in the items array with `{ error }`; the stream continues. Closed-by-default: 404 surfaces as a `feature_not_enabled` error tagged with the `v2_streaming` tenant flag.

items.description: Items to evaluate (1-100). Decisions returned in input order.

name: atlasent_evaluate_stream
title: AtlaSent — Evaluate (streamed, buffered)
